_doc: The rig's one machine catalog, read by vagrant/Vagrantfile and rig.py. MATRIX.md says
what each row proves; this file says how to boot it. One entry per machine; `boxes`
maps a Vagrant provider to the box that provides the row on it (a provider without an
entry cannot run that machine). Providers: libvirt (Linux hosts, x86_64), hyperv
(Windows hosts), qemu (Apple Silicon hosts, arm64 guests), virtualbox (optional, any
x86_64 host). Fields: guest linux|windows; matrix = the MATRIX.md row; provision = the
toolchain script, relative to the rig's root (the directory holding agent/); prep = box
fix-ups from provisioning/, run before it (each detects whether its box needs it);
qemu_ssh_port = the host port the QEMU plugin forwards (it cannot auto-allocate);
memory_mb overrides the default; notes = what to know before `up`.

ubuntu2404.notes: hyperv box boots an Azure 6.17 kernel and has a 1 GB /home: see vagrant/README.md 'ubuntu2404 on Hyper-V'.

ubuntu2204.notes: glibc 2.35 / GCC 12: the prebuilt ONNX Runtime does not link, see README.md 'ONNX Runtime on older distros'.

debian12.notes: glibc 2.36 / GCC 12: the prebuilt ONNX Runtime does not link, see README.md 'ONNX Runtime on older distros'.

debian13.notes: hyperv box ships without rsync: see vagrant/README.md 'debian13 on Hyper-V'.

fedora41.notes: SELinux Enforcing on purpose. hyperv box: small LVM volumes, toolchain and target live under /var/synthaea.

rocky9.notes: Replay-only row: no LLVM recent enough for the probes, and glibc 2.34 cannot link the prebuilt ONNX Runtime.

arch.notes: x86_64 only. A rolling target: run `sudo pacman -Syu` after `up` for the current kernel.

alpine319.notes: Alpine 3.19 / 6.6 (the newest generic box), standing in for the 3.24 row's musl/BusyBox coverage. No prebuilt ONNX Runtime for musl: build with --ort static.

win11.notes: WinRM. No synced folder: `rig.py build` uploads the sources.

win10.notes: WinRM. No synced folder: `rig.py build` uploads the sources.

winserver.notes: WinRM. No synced folder: `rig.py build` uploads the sources.
